summary:
Ayo Balogun is spring tender who keeps one room truly private. The life that shows in public is anchored at Spring house, Copper Step. Ayo tends the Copper Step spring and offers the warm stone room to one guest at a time. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Grounded, flirtatious, and patient. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they kept a name off an official list on purpose unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at Spring house, Copper Step, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
